offensive.name: Living Weaponry
offensive.description: Turn body into blades, tendrils, and horrors — hardening sinew into weapons until the caster themselves becomes something biology never intended.

tiers.text: Create biological weapons — hardened bone spikes, veins twisted into whips. Your unarmed strikes now deal 1d8 sinew damage.
tiers.card: Unarmed strikes become 1d8 sinew — bone spikes, vein whips

tiers.text: Gain multiattack (2) with unarmed strikes or body weapons. Targets struck must succeed on a Constitution save or be grappled by muscle fibers extending from the strike.
tiers.card: Two unarmed attacks · struck targets Con save or grappled by muscle fibre

tiers.text: Grow a temporary monstrous feature — tentacle limb, quilled back, or acid gland. Gain one biological trait (breath weapon, defensive spine, or burrowing movement) for 1 hour.
tiers.card: Grow a monstrous feature 1 hr — breath weapon, defensive spines, or a burrow speed

tiers.text: Enter the Flesh Ascendant state for 1 minute — you count as an aberration, gain temporary HP equal to your level × 20, and your natural weapons count as magical +5.
tiers.card: Flesh Ascendant 1 min — count as aberration, temp HP = level × 20, natural weapons magical +5

supportive.name: Regenerative Twist
supportive.description: Accelerate or hijack the body's repair process — closing wounds and regrowing limbs with the same motion that, pointed differently, turns regeneration cancerous.

tiers.text: A target you touch heals 1d6 HP or takes 1d6 sinew damage (your choice). This healing cannot affect undead or constructs.
tiers.card: Touch: heal 1d6 or deal 1d6 sinew, your choice (not undead or constructs)

tiers.text: Reattach limbs, close deep wounds, or spur cellular regeneration — removing 1 Wound per round or regrowing a minor body part over 1 hour.
tiers.card: Reattach limbs, close deep wounds — 1 Wound per round, or a minor part over an hour

tiers.text: As part of casting, mutate a creature's organ — the target must make a Constitution save or gain 1 Injury as their own biology works against them.
tiers.card: Mutate an organ — Con save or take 1 Injury as their own biology turns

tiers.text: Redirect regeneration violently — a regenerating creature instead bloats, grows tumors, or collapses, taking necrotic + sinew damage equal to your level as their immortality turns cancerous.
tiers.card: A regenerating creature bloats instead — necrotic + sinew equal to your level

control.name: Meatshaper's Grasp
control.description: Reshape the living flesh — twisting limbs and dislocating joints before eventually replacing entire body parts with something better or worse.

tiers.text: The target's muscles or limbs twist unnaturally — they have disadvantage on Strength or Dexterity checks (your choice) for 1 round.
tiers.card: Muscles twist — disadvantage on Str or Dex checks, your pick, 1 round

penalty.disadvantage: Strength or Dexterity checks (your choice) for 1 r

tiers.text: Alter a limb's function — dislocate a knee, reduce grip, or hyperextend a joint. The target suffers −1 AC, drops one held item, or takes sinew damage equal to half your level.
tiers.card: Dislocate a joint — −1 AC, drop a held item, or half your level in sinew

tiers.text: Reshape flesh into armor or weapons on a willing creature — granting temporary natural armor (AC = 20 + Constitution modifier) or a meaty weapon dealing 4d8 sinew damage (versatile) for 1 hour.
tiers.card: Reshape a willing creature — natural armour (AC 20 + Con) or a 4d8 sinew weapon, 1 hr

tiers.text: Create or replace entire body parts — granting natural weapons, extra limbs, tentacles, or organic mutations at DM discretion. Each replacement costs HP or Cognition fatigue equal to the complexity of the change.
tiers.card: Create or replace whole body parts — extra limbs, tentacles, natural weapons. Costs HP or fatigue

control.name: Flesh Memory
control.description: Scar the body with truths that last — embedding trauma into tissue until wounds trigger hallucinations and living organs carry spells indefinitely.

tiers.text: Mark a creature's flesh with a symbolic wound or memory rune. They have disadvantage on Deception checks against the truth you etched for 24 hours.
tiers.card: Mark flesh with a memory rune — disadvantage on Deception about that truth, 24 hrs

penalty.disadvantage: Deception checks against the truth you etched for

tiers.text: Embed a memory in flesh — when the creature is next wounded, they suffer hallucinations of past trauma and must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Stunned for 1 round.
tiers.card: Next time they're wounded: Wis save or Stunned 1 round by hallucinated trauma

tiers.text: Mark yourself with Resonant Flesh — while concentrating, you can see through the eyes or feel the pain of any creature whose flesh you have marked.
tiers.card: Resonant Flesh — while concentrating, see through or feel any flesh you have marked

tiers.text: Create a Flesh Anchor — a living organ made of your own tissue that can store a spell, memory, or emotional Cognition. It may be grafted into another willing creature, persisting indefinitely until removed.
tiers.card: Flesh Anchor — a living organ storing a spell, memory or Cognition, graftable and permanent

control.name: Organic Dominion
control.description: Command flesh as a sovereign force — stripping reactions, causing nerve pain, and eventually puppeting the paralyzed or the dead as extensions of your own body.

tiers.text: Command or repulse one creature with a natural body (not constructs or oozes) — on a failed Charisma save they lose their next reaction.
tiers.card: Fail: loses its next reaction (natural bodies only, no constructs or oozes)

tiers.text: Cause phantom nerve pain in an unused part of the body — the target takes 1d8 sinew damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or drop Concentration.
tiers.card: Phantom nerve pain — 1d8 sinew and a Con save or Concentration drops

tiers.text: Dominate the body — forcibly bend limbs or lock muscles. On a failed save, the target cannot move or use one specific limb for 1 round.
tiers.card: Fail: cannot move or use one limb for 1 round

tiers.text: Puppet a corpse or paralyzed creature for 1 minute — using its body as an extension of your own. You act through it with its physical stats and your mental actions, sharing its senses while the puppeting lasts.
tiers.card: Puppet a corpse or paralyzed creature 1 min — its body, your mind, its senses

creation.name: Grafted Work
creation.description: A body is a system, and a system can be built.

tiers.text: Your creations are living tissue. Structures regain 5 hit points per segment at the start of each of your turns and are unnervingly warm. Objects are living sinew — they deal +1d4 sinew damage and cannot be disarmed.
tiers.card: Creations are living tissue, warm · Structures regain 5 HP/segment each of your turns · Objects +1d4 sinew, undisarmable

tiers.text: Your creations have resistance to piercing and slashing damage and immunity to poison damage. A creature that touches or strikes a Structure must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC or be grappled by muscle fibers until it escapes.
tiers.card: Resist piercing and slashing, immune to poison · touching a Structure: Con save {DC} or grappled by muscle fibre

tiers.text: Constructs may reshape themselves — once per turn, changing one natural weapon, gaining a climb or swim speed, or squeezing through any gap a limb can fit. A destroyed Object regrows at the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: Constructs reshape 1/turn — new natural weapon, climb or swim speed, squeeze anywhere · destroyed Objects regrow

tiers.text: Your creations are Ascendant flesh — they count as aberrations, are immune to critical hits, and a Construct may graft a willing ally, granting them the Construct's natural weapon and speed for the duration.
tiers.card: Ascendant flesh — aberrations, immune to crits · a Construct may graft an ally its weapon and speed

utility.name: Surgeon's Hand
utility.description: Medicine and violence are the same gesture at different intensities.

tiers.text: Learn a creature's injuries, ailments, age, and recent trauma by touch. Set a bone, close a wound, or stop a bleed without a check. Alter your own features — face, build, voice — for 1 hour.
tiers.card: Read injuries, ailments, age and trauma by touch · set bones and stop bleeds · reshape your own face 1 hr

tiers.text: Alter a willing creature's appearance for 8 hours, convincingly enough to pass. Grant a willing creature a minor useful adaptation — gills, padded feet, a climbing grip.
tiers.card: Alter a willing creature's appearance 8 hrs · grant a minor adaptation — gills, padded feet, a climbing grip

tiers.text: Read a corpse's flesh for the last hour of its life. Graft a nonmagical organ, limb, or feature onto a willing creature, permanently.
tiers.card: Read a corpse's last hour · graft an organ, limb or feature permanently

tiers.text: Rebuild a willing creature's body into the form they have always believed was theirs — permanently, without pain, and without cost to their health.
tiers.card: Rebuild a willing body into the form they always believed was theirs — permanent, painless, free

complementEffects.name: Exposed Nerve
complementEffects.description: The primary effect leaves something raw and open — the next source of damage fires every nerve in the affected area at once for amplified sinew pain.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target's pain receptors are left hypersensitive — the next time they take damage before the end of your next turn, that damage deals +1d8 sinew bonus damage.
effect.card: Nerves left raw — their next damage taken before your next turn is +1d8

upgrades.text: The hypersensitivity lingers for 1 minute, the bonus damage increases to +2d8, and each time the bonus triggers the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC or have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
upgrades.card: Lasts 1 min · +2d8 · Con save {DC} each time it triggers

upgrades.text: The bonus damage increases to +3d8, and while the hypersensitivity persists the target has disadvantage on Concentration checks — every incidental impact sending a cascade of amplified sensation through them.
upgrades.card: +3d8 · disadvantage on Concentration while it persists

penalty.disadvantage: Concentration checks — every incidental impact sen

complementEffects.name: Flesh Knit
complementEffects.description: Biology accelerates where it is needed most — minor wounds closing of their own accord as the body's repair process is briefly redirected toward an ally.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally of your choice within 30 feet regains hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus as minor wounds close of their own accord.

upgrades.text: The healing increases to twice your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus, and the ally also removes one condition affecting them as the biological surge pushes the ailment out.
upgrades.card: Healing doubles · also removes one condition

upgrades.text: You may choose two allies to receive this benefit, and each also removes one Wound — the flesh knitting past surface damage into deeper repair.
upgrades.card: Two allies · each also removes one Wound

complementEffects.name: Muscle Lock
complementEffects.description: The body betrays itself — muscles seizing involuntarily, stripping speed and coordination before the target can understand what their own flesh is doing.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC or have their muscles seize involuntarily — their movement speed is reduced by 15 feet and they have disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Con save {DC} or muscles seize — speed halved, no reactions

penalty.disadvantage: Strength and Dexterity checks until the end of the

upgrades.text: On a failed save, the target also cannot take the Dash action and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn — their body fighting every deliberate movement.
upgrades.card: Also can't Dash and attacks at disadvantage

penalty.disadvantage: attack rolls until the end of their next turn — th

upgrades.text: Creatures that fail are also unable to use reactions until the end of their next turn, and any attempt to cast a spell with somatic components requires a successful Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC first — their hands too locked to gesture cleanly.
upgrades.card: Also no reactions · somatic casting needs a Con check {DC}
